暂停视图，菜单栏继续采集: Pause view; menu bar keeps sampling
可用空间包含可回收部分；缓存单独列于内存详情。: Available memory includes reclaimable pages. Cache is listed in memory details.
按 App 包归并进程的物理内存占用。: Physical memory grouped by application bundle.
单核占满为 100%；这不是 App 功耗排名。: 100% represents one full core. This does not measure app power consumption.
CPU 温度尚未接入可靠的无提权接口；不使用电池温度替代。: CPU temperature requires a reliable unprivileged source and is not implemented. Battery temperature is a separate metric.
等待第二个 CPU 样本: Waiting for the second CPU sample
来源：Mach host_processor_info。总使用率按所有逻辑核心的: Source: Mach host_processor_info. Total usage is weighted by counter deltas across all logical cores.
来源：Mach host_statistics64 与 sysctl。已用 =: Sources: Mach host_statistics64 and sysctl. Used = app + wired + compressed. App = active + inactive + speculative − purgeable − file pages. Memory uses binary GiB/MiB; disk capacity uses decimal GB/MB.
显示首个提供完整计数的 GPU。硬件与 macOS 版本变化可能导致此接口不可用: Shows the first GPU with complete counters. Availability depends on hardware and macOS version.
关闭窗口后，容量仍会在菜单栏持续更新。: Capacity continues updating in the menu bar after closing the window.
秒采集容量。可写空间不含系统可能回收的空间。: seconds. Available space excludes potentially reclaimable system space.
I/O 包含外置存储和系统报告的块设备；累计计数从驱动启动计起。APFS 容量只: I/O includes external storage and system-reported block devices. Totals start when the driver starts. APFS capacity is read once from the data volume.
VPN、桥接与虚拟接口单独列出，避免重复累计同一份流量。: VPN, bridge and virtual interfaces are listed separately to avoid counting traffic twice.
来源：路由接口表 NET_RT_IFLIST2 的 64 位计数。新出现或重置的: Source: 64-bit NET_RT_IFLIST2 routing interface counters. New or reset interfaces establish a baseline before showing rates.
当前设备未报告内置电池；进程 CPU 活动仍可查看。: This device reports no built-in battery. Process CPU activity is still available.
电池功率按电压 × 瞬时电流计算。温度是电池温度，不是 CPU 温度。: Battery power is voltage × instantaneous current. Temperature refers to the battery, not the CPU.
来自 AppleSmartBattery 的 PowerTelemetryDat: Hardware telemetry from AppleSmartBattery PowerTelemetryData.SystemLoad; this is not wall outlet power.
当前硬件未提供系统功率遥测: System power telemetry is unavailable on this hardware
当前未接入 App 级瓦特计量。CPU 活跃进程有助于定位负载，但不能据此换算各: Per-app watt measurements are not implemented. CPU activity helps identify load but cannot determine each app's power consumption.
进程采集独立于窗口绘制运行。: Process sampling runs independently of window rendering.
试试其他名称或 PID，或取消“仅我的进程”。: Try another name or PID, or turn off “Only my processes”.
进程 CPU 以单逻辑核 100% 计，可超过 100%。内存为 phys_fo: Process CPU uses 100% per logical core and may exceed 100%. Memory is phys_footprint; shared pages mean process totals differ from system usage. Viewing only; no process termination.
读取当前权限可见的 TCP / UDP 套接字。: Reading TCP / UDP sockets visible with current permissions.
当前权限下没有匹配的 TCP / UDP 记录，可调整搜索或刷新。: No matching TCP / UDP records are visible. Adjust your search or refresh.
来源：本机 lsof。只包含当前权限可见的套接字，不提权、不解析远端域名，不向这: Source: local lsof. Only sockets visible with current permissions are included. No elevation, remote DNS lookup or requests to these addresses.
将同一个 App 包中的进程归并显示。: Processes from the same application bundle are grouped together.
按 App 包路径归并 · 不含未启动的 App: Grouped by bundle path · running apps only
试试其他名称，或查看完整进程列表。: Try another name or view the full process list.
只读查看运行状态。物理占用来自各进程 phys_footprint 之和；此页面: Read-only running status. Physical memory sums process phys_footprint values. This page does not uninstall apps or delete their data.
空间分析只读取文件大小，不删除文件。缓存可能仍被 App 使用；下载和废纸篓也不: Space analysis reads file sizes without deleting files. Caches may still be in use; downloads and trash are not necessarily safe to remove.
逐项读取配置的目录。遇到权限限制会标注，达到时间或数量上限会返回已读部分。: Reading configured directories. Permission restrictions are reported; time or entry limits return partial results.
分析应用缓存、日志、下载文件和废纸篓。文件内容不会被读取。: Analyze app caches, logs, downloads and trash. File contents are not read.
部分目录无法读取。以下数据仅代表成功读取的文件。: Some directories could not be read. Results include only successfully read files.
· 逻辑文件大小，不代表实际可释放空间: · Logical sizes, not guaranteed reclaimable space
项因权限或读取错误跳过。: items skipped due to permission or read errors.
不跟随符号链接。按第一层目录汇总并显示体积最大的项目；硬链接与 APFS 克隆可: Symbolic links are not followed. Results group by top-level directory and show the largest items. Hard links and APFS clones may count more than once. Scope and limits are configured in localops.json.
已验证平台：当前 macOS Apple Silicon。本次不包含 Windo: Desktop behavior has been verified on macOS Apple Silicon. Windows/Linux collectors, CPU temperature, per-app power, uninstall, deletion and process termination are not implemented.
数据仅在本机读取。GPU 与系统功率使用系统注册表提供的硬件计数，接口可用性随机: Data is read locally. GPU and system power use hardware counters from the system registry; availability depends on hardware and OS version.
点击右上角刷新重新连接采集服务。: Use Refresh in the top right to reconnect to the collector.

默认跟随系统语言；不支持的语言使用英文。: Follows your system language by default. Unsupported languages use English.
选择需要常驻的指标。保存后立即生效，关闭窗口也会持续更新。: Choose persistent metrics. Saved changes take effect immediately and keep updating while the window is closed.
全部关闭时仅保留 LocalOps 图标。显示项目越多，占用的菜单栏空间越宽。: Turn off all metrics to keep only the LocalOps icon. More metrics use more menu bar space.
当前用户可写的剩余容量: Space available to the current user
全部逻辑核心的总使用率: Total usage across all logical cores
已用内存占总内存的比例: Used memory as a share of total memory
物理网络接口的下载与上传速度: Download and upload speed of physical interfaces
剩余电量，无电池时显示 —: Remaining charge; shows — without a battery
按可执行文件路径归并进程的常驻内存占用。: Groups resident memory by executable path.
来源：操作系统逐核 CPU 时间计数。总使用率按所有逻辑核心的时间增量加权计算；: Source: per-core operating system CPU time counters. Total usage is weighted by elapsed core time. Linux I/O wait counts as idle.
已用 = 总物理内存 − 系统报告的可用内存。Linux 包含可回收缓存的可用估: Used = total physical memory minus OS-reported available memory. Linux availability includes reclaimable cache; Windows uses available physical pages. Swap means page files on Windows. Memory uses GiB/MiB.
Linux 优先显示首个提供计数的 AMD GPU，否则查询 NVIDIA 的首: Linux selects the first AMD GPU exposing counters, otherwise the first NVIDIA GPU. Windows queries the first NVIDIA GPU. Counters missing from the driver are unavailable.
Windows 汇总固定磁盘卷的 I/O；Linux 汇总硬件块设备，排除分区和: Windows sums fixed-volume I/O; Linux sums hardware block devices, excluding partitions and virtual layers. Capacity covers only the filesystem containing your home directory.
Windows 使用 GetIfEntry2，Linux 使用 /proc/ne: Windows uses GetIfEntry2; Linux uses /proc/net/dev and sysfs device identity. Totals include hardware interfaces, with all interfaces listed separately. New or reset counters establish a fresh baseline.
进程 CPU 以单逻辑核 100% 计，可超过 100%。内存为常驻集 RSS；: Process CPU uses 100% per logical core and may exceed 100%. Memory is RSS, so shared pages can be counted more than once. Inaccessible I/O is unavailable. Inspection only; no process termination.
来源：Windows 系统连接表或 Linux procfs。只包含当前权限可见: Source: Windows connection tables or Linux procfs. Only sockets visible with current permissions are included; process ownership may be unavailable. No elevation, DNS lookups, or outgoing requests.
按可执行文件路径归并 · 仅含运行中的进程: Grouped by executable path · running processes only
只读查看运行状态。内存为各进程 RSS 之和，共享页可能重复计入；此页面不执行卸: Read-only inspection. Memory sums process RSS and may count shared pages more than once. No uninstalling or deletion.
Windows 显示系统电池状态；Linux 显示 sysfs 中首个系统电池，: Windows shows system battery status. Linux shows the first system battery in sysfs and available driver power, health and temperature counters. Temperature refers to the battery.
支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 系统采集。CPU 温度、App: System monitoring supports macOS, Windows and Linux. CPU temperature, per-app watts, uninstalling, deletion and process termination are outside the current feature set.
数据仅在本机读取。GPU、电池和功率计数的可用性取决于硬件、驱动及当前权限；没有: All data is read locally. GPU, battery and power availability depends on hardware, drivers and permissions. Missing counters are shown as unavailable.
分析下列配置目录的文件大小。文件内容不会被读取。: Measures file sizes in the configured directories below without reading file contents.
